items.title: a) By using Filter Paper (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: a) By using Filter Paper: a main subheading of Filtration (printed as a second 15.1), its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 324-325.

blocks.text: Filter paper ko sahi tarah morna (fold karna) zaroori hai, aur yeh do tareeqon se hota hai.

1. Glass funnel aur filter paper se filtration aam taur par aahista hoti hai. Jab mixture filter paper par dala jata hai to solvent (pani) guzar jata hai aur suspended particles (pani mein tairte zarre) paper par reh jate hain. Filter papers different (alag alag) porosity (pore size, yani soorakhon ka size) mein milte hain. Kaun sa pore size lena hai, yeh precipitate ke particles ke size par depend karta hai. Filter paper itna bara ho ke filtration ke aakhir mein woh ek chauthai (one-fourth) se aadha (one-half) precipitate se bhara ho. Is tarah filtrate chhinte urae baghair beaker ki deewar ke saath neeche utarta hai. Poora filtration assembly Figure 15.1 mein dikhaya gaya hai.

blocks.alt: Teen drawings: gol filter paper jis ke beech dashed lakeer (pehla mor), aadha daira jis par aari dashed lakeer (doosra mor), aur paper ko khol kar bana cone.
blocks.caption: Figure 15.2a: Filter paper ko morna (folding) (kitab ki Figure 15.2a ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.text: Mora hua filter paper phir 60-degree funnel mein rakha jata hai, pani se geela kiya jata hai aur zor se daba diya jata hai.

2. Conical funnel se filtration ki speed Fluted Filter Paper se kafi barh jati hai. Is ke liye aam filter paper ko is tarah mora jata hai ke pankhe (fan) jaisi shakal ban jaye, jis mein bari bari ubhar (elevations) aur gehrai (depressions) hon, Fig 15.2 b.

blocks.alt: Saat steps: filter disk; aadha morein; phir aadha morein; chauthai hisse ki silwat; aathwein hisse ki silwat; pankhe jaisi accordion shakal; khula filter cone.
blocks.caption: Figure 15.2b: Fluted (silwaton wala) filter paper (kitab ki Figure 15.2b ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Teer ki direction dekhein: oopar ki line baayen se daayen, phir neeche aa kar daayen se baayen. Har mor par kaghaz par nayi crease (silwat) banti hai; aakhir mein kaghaz pankhe ki tarah ubhar aur gehrai wala ho jata hai. Is se funnel aur kaghaz ke beech hawa ka raasta rehta hai aur filtration tez hoti hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki caption mein 'Fluttled filter paper' chhapa hai; sahi lafz 'Fluted' (silwaton wala) hai.
Filtration ke baad funnel ke neeche conical flask mein jo liquid jama hota hai use filtrate kehte hain. Funnel par jo ret bach jati hai use residue kehte hain.
